verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is the speech-configuration page, which lets you 'control exactly when your assistant starts and stops speaking'. Nothing in the pack says this uses a model-based end-of-turn or smart-endpointing detector rather than VAD silence timeouts, so it counts only as an adjacent control. Absent evidence of model-based turn detection, the applicable axis is unproven.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use model-based end-of-turn detection beyond simple VAD silence timeouts so the agent doesn't talk over slow speakers
